steps.name: Wire embyr-admin ServeDir + WASM entry + trunk build
criteria: GET /admin/ returns 200 with Content-Type: text/html containing <script
embyr-admin binary starts an Axum TCP listener on the configured port
trunk build --release produces dist/ directory with a .wasm file
admin_spa_http_probe test passes (currently not #[ignore])
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: admin_spa_http_probe is NOT #[ignore] — it must go GREEN. This test starts an in-process Axum server with ServeDir at /admin/, sends reqwest GET, asserts 200 + HTML body contains '<script'. To make it pass: (1) wire embyr-admin/src/main.rs as a real Axum server with tower-http ServeDir; (2) run 'trunk build --release' in crates/embyr-admin-ui to produce dist/; (3) embyr-admin ServeDir points to the dist/ directory. The WASM entry (src/main.rs) must call mount_to_body(App). app.rs creates RwSignal<AppModel> + Callback<Msg> via leptos::provide_context. model.rs and msg.rs are already scaffolded — remove SCAFFOLD markers and fill AppModel::from_mock() with data::mock::databases() etc. update.rs panic stub becomes real match arms. data.rs mock::* fns return hardcoded Vec<T>. PREREQUISITE: trunk CLI must be installed ('cargo install trunk'). Add tower-http = { version = '0.5', features = ['fs'] } to embyr-admin/Cargo.toml.

steps.name: Auth TEA state: SignIn, SignOut, TotpFailure, TotpSuccess
criteria: Msg::SignIn sets model.authed = true
Msg::SignOut sets model.authed = false
Three Msg::TotpFailure in sequence sets model.locked = true
Msg::TotpSuccess resets failure counter and locked=false
sign_in_sets_authed, sign_out_clears_authed, three_totp_failures_lock_account, totp_success_resets_failure_counter proptest passes
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: Remove #[ignore] from sign_in_sets_authed, sign_out_clears_authed, three_totp_failures_lock_account, totp_success_resets_failure_counter in tea_state_scenarios.rs. These are proptest! macros — run via 'cargo test --package embyr-admin-ui --test user_admin_ui_tea_state'. update() match arms needed: Msg::SignIn => model.authed = true; Msg::SignOut => { model.authed = false; model.nav = NavState::default(); }; Msg::TotpFailure => { model.totp_failures += 1; if model.totp_failures >= 3 { model.locked = true; } }; Msg::TotpSuccess => { model.totp_failures = 0; model.locked = false; }. model.rs needs: totp_failures: u8, locked: bool fields on AppModel. Remove __SCAFFOLD__ and // SCAFFOLD: true markers from update.rs and model.rs.

steps.name: Dashboard + Database CRUD TEA state (US-002, US-003, US-004)
criteria: Msg::SetDatabases populates model.databases excluding Deleted entries
Msg::DatabaseCreated appends db to model.databases
Msg::SetDbStatus updates matching database status
Msg::DeleteDatabase removes db and cascades to sdk_keys
All 9 related proptest scenarios pass (set_databases_*, database_created_*, delete_database_*, set_db_logging_*)
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: Remove #[ignore] from set_databases_populates_model, set_databases_excludes_deleted, database_created_appends_db, delete_database_removes_db_and_sdk_keys, set_db_status_updates_database, set_db_status_missing_id_is_noop, set_db_logging_enables_logging, set_db_logging_disables_logging, set_db_logging_wrong_id_is_noop. Implement Msg arms: SetDatabases => model.databases = dbs.into_iter().filter(|d| d.status != DbStatus::Deleted).collect(); DatabaseCreated => model.databases.push(db); SetDbStatus => find db by id, set status; DeleteDatabase => remove db + remove all sdk_keys entries for that db_id; SetDbLogging => find db by id, set logging fields. data.rs mock::databases() should return Vec<Database> with 2-3 hardcoded entries covering direct_pg and agent_mode backends.

steps.name: Connections backend config + SDK key create/revoke (US-005, US-006)
criteria: Msg::PatchDb updates matching database backend config fields
Msg::PatchDb with unknown id is a no-op
Msg::SdkKeyCreated appends key to model.sdk_keys[db_id]
Msg::RevokeSdkKey removes matching key; unknown key is no-op
All 6 proptest scenarios pass (patch_db_*, sdk_key_*, revoke_sdk_key_*)
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: Remove #[ignore] from patch_db_updates_backend_config, patch_db_missing_id_is_noop, sdk_key_created_appends_key, revoke_sdk_key_removes_key, revoke_sdk_key_missing_key_is_noop, sdk_key_created_unknown_db_is_noop. PatchDb arm: find db by id, apply DbPatch enum variants (UpdateDsn, UpdateAgentEndpoint, UpdateSecretBackend, UpdateSecretName). SdkKeyCreated: model.sdk_keys.entry(db_id).or_default().push(key). RevokeSdkKey: model.sdk_keys.entry(db_id).and_modify(|keys| keys.retain(|k| k.id != key_id)). data.rs mock::sdk_keys(db_id) returns 2 hardcoded SdkKey entries.

steps.name: Members + sole-Owner invariant (US-009)
criteria: Msg::MemberInvited appends member to model.members
Msg::SetMemberRole updates role for matching member
Msg::RemoveMember removes non-Owner; sole-Owner removal is a no-op
sole_owner_invariant_holds_after_member_removal proptest passes
sole_owner_invariant_holds_after_role_change proptest passes
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: Remove #[ignore] from member_invited_appends_member, set_member_role_updates_role, remove_member_removes_non_owner, sole_owner_invariant_holds_after_member_removal, sole_owner_invariant_holds_after_role_change, remove_member_missing_uid_is_noop. CRITICAL invariant: RemoveMember must check that at least one other Owner exists before removing. Helper: fn count_owners(members: &[Member]) -> usize { members.iter().filter(|m| m.role == Role::Owner).count() }. RemoveMember arm: let is_sole_owner = model.members.iter().find(|m| m.id == uid).map(|m| m.role == Role::Owner).unwrap_or(false) && count_owners(&model.members) == 1; if !is_sole_owner { model.members.retain(|m| m.id != uid); }. SetMemberRole: same sole-owner check before demotion.

steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: Remove #[ignore] from service_account_created_appends, delete_service_account_removes_it, admin_key_created_appends, revoke_admin_key_removes_key, revoke_admin_key_missing_is_noop. steps.name: trunk build --release + bundle size gate < 5 MB
criteria: trunk build --release completes without error
Total dist/ directory size < 5 MB
.wasm file exists in dist/
wasm_bundle_size_gate test passes (remove #[ignore])
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: Remove #[ignore] from wasm_bundle_size_gate. This test checks std::fs::metadata on the .wasm file in crates/embyr-admin-ui/dist/ (or admin-ui/dist/ depending on trunk output path). Run 'trunk build --release' in crates/embyr-admin-ui/. If bundle > 5 MB: audit web-sys features in Cargo.toml — only include features actually used (Window, Document, Element, MouseEvent, KeyboardEvent, Navigator, Clipboard, ClipboardItem). wasm-opt is invoked automatically by trunk in release mode for tree-shaking. If still over budget, profile with 'twiggy dominators' or 'wasm-pack build --profiling'. Expected size: ~810 KB – 1.4 MB compressed. PREREQUISITE: trunk installed ('cargo install trunk'); wasm32-unknown-unknown target added ('rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown').
